messages:
ana: Heads-up: we're planning an auth header deprecation for Partner API — target hard cut 2025-05-15. Need partner notification + marketplace coordination.

mike: timeline?

ana: Deprecation announcement 2025-03-15, 60-day migration window, hard enforcement 2025-05-15.

sarah: Quick Q — can we ship a compatibility SDK that accepts the old header for one more release? Buyers on marketplace rely on SDK integrate scripts.

mike: Yes, we can publish V2 SDKs that keep old-header support and log warnings. We'll also add a telemetry flag for any old-header usage.

raj: From SI side: need a clear checklist for integrators. Steps: 1) swap header, 2) smoke test, 3) verify tracing/kv cache. Also need a sandbox token that mimics partner production traffic.

julia (partner-success): I'll start compiling the partner contact list. Please DM me any missing SI contacts.

mike: Technical migration snippet for docs (put in partner guide):
```
# previous
X-Redwood-Key: abc123
# new
Authorization: Bearer abc123
```
We should include curl and node examples.

ana: Also we need a partner-facing timeline email, an RFC-style migration checklist, and a changelog entry for the public marketplace listing update. Marketing/product must align on messaging.

sarah: I'll own the marketplace copy and the partner FAQ draft. Recommend we avoid 'breaking' language in public copy — use 'security header update' + migration steps. For partners we can be explicit.

ana: Proposed action items:
1) @julia gather and confirm partner + SI contacts by EOD Wed
2) @mike publish SDK compatibility release + docs by next Tue
3) @sarah draft marketplace notice + partner FAQ by next Fri
4) @raj produce canary test plan and shortlist 3 partners to trial

julia (partner-success): On it. I'll ping partners with a pre-notice template and ask for preferred maintenance windows.

mike: We should add server-side telemetry to flag old-header usage (metric: partnerships.old_auth_header.count) and export to partner console so they can self-check.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled: partners-canary-01 -> 2025-03-01T04:00Z :robot_face:

raj: For canary, we'll whitelist partner org IDs and issue scoped test tokens. I'll draft the runbook with rollback steps.

ana: Meeting to sync tomorrow 10:00a PT — short stand (15m) to confirm owners and dates. If partners ask for more time we can extend window.

julia (partner-success): Draft pre-notice is up in #partnerships-drafts, please review.

sarah: +1 to joint runbook. I'll add a section for marketplace listing updates and note who to loop in for joint announcements.

ana: Thanks everyone — I'll consolidate and create the official partner advisory doc after tomorrow's sync.
